title: Reading Basic Financial Statements: Cash Flow Statement
summary: BLUE-L2-045: Reading Basic Financial Statements: Cash Flow Statement.
body: This BLUE Level 2 lesson develops practical business competence in Reading Basic Financial Statements: Cash Flow Statement. Learners should identify how the decision affects cash flow, profitability, liability, taxation, operations, customers and strategic flexibility rather than treating any business decision in isolation. Rules for business entities, tax, employment, licensing and financial reporting vary by jurisdiction, so current official requirements and qualified local advice should be used where appropriate. The objective is applied reasoning: understand the numbers, test assumptions, examine downside scenarios and make deliberate business decisions.
